highlights_headline: Upcoming changes improve callback ABI correctness, Android frame pacing, and Uno Platform 7 compatibility.
highlights_body: They also correct Unicode validation, Linux HarfBuzz symbol conflicts, and WebGPU application linking. Review Apple minimums, Uno control behavior, and SKData length validation before upgrading.

breaking.title: Apple native deployment baselines raised
breaking.body: Native SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now require macOS 11 or iOS/tvOS/Mac Catalyst 14. Managed iOS/tvOS minimums rise to 14; managed macOS 12 and Mac Catalyst 15 requirements remain higher. Raise application deployment targets as needed without lowering existing managed or framework requirements.

breaking.title: Uno views require Uno Platform 7
breaking.body: The non-Windows Uno views assembly now requires .NET 10 and Uno 7; pre-Uno 7 WasmShell pipelines are no longer supported. SKSwapChainPanel becomes a Grid-based CPU fallback with null GRContext and drops RaiseOnUnsupported. Use SKCanvasElement for Uno GPU rendering. The Windows facade retains its ANGLE-backed control.

breaking.title: SKData copy lengths are checked
breaking.body: SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the requested length exceeds the array. Pass a length within the source array instead of relying on an out-of-bounds native read.

breaking.title: WebGPU links require updated native archives
breaking.body: The emdawnwebgpu C++ support now ships inside libSkiaSharp.a rather than compiling on the application link line. Use matching rebuilt Graphite-enabled archives; older or GPU-disabled custom archives do not satisfy the new contract. The .NET 8 built-in WebGPU path is retained.

bullets.detail: Skia callbacks use one-byte native bool values and HarfBuzz callbacks use four-byte hb_bool_t values. Public managed delegates remain bool; false-returning glyph-name callbacks no longer copy an invalid name.

GetUnicodeCharacterCode validates a single encoded unit and decodes its byte width correctly: ASCII for UTF-8, BMP for UTF-16, and a Unicode scalar for UTF-32. GetString now reports ArgumentNullException for null byte arrays.

bullets.lead: Linux HarfBuzz calls stay within the bundled library
bullets.detail: Prevents ELF symbol preemption from mixing bundled and system HarfBuzz objects when GTK loads system HarfBuzz first, without changing exported hb_* entry points.

bullets.lead: Android continuous texture rendering follows display refresh
bullets.detail: Uses Choreographer pulses for automatic frames while keeping GL work on its worker thread. Explicit render requests and synchronous lifecycle progress remain independent; this does not promise presentation timing.

bullets.lead: WebGPU application links no longer compile the C++ port
bullets.detail: Moves port compilation into libSkiaSharp.a so application C sources are not passed incompatible C++ flags. JavaScript glue remains a link input rather than deployed application content.
Rejects shader slot-count overflow and invalid runtime-effect types earlier.
Ganesh GL no longer advertises unsupported BGRA8-as-RGBx uploads in GLES; readback is unchanged.
Corrects a native buffer over-read in FromCString.

bullets.lead: Borrowed front-buffered streams are released without disposal
bullets.detail: Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream clears its reference to the wrapped stream even when disposeUnderlyingStream is false. The caller still owns disposal of the borrowed stream.
Valid managed image pixel copies avoid intermediate SKData allocation while preserving native validation for invalid inputs.
HarfBuzzSharp pools UTF-32 encoding buffers and uses bounded stack storage for feature strings while preserving decoding behavior.
WinUI/MAUI library inputs align with Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003. The separately bundled WinUI ANGLE advances to chromium/8118; declared Windows runtime minimums are unchanged.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Moved WebGPU C++ support into native archives and rebuilt Uno views for Uno Platform 7
contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Fixed Linux HarfBuzz symbol preemption and made Blazor CPU sample tests wait for the first paint
contributor_summaries.dalexsoto: Addressed contextual PoliCheck findings in CI
